reviews.t: QUICK & EASY! One shade only.
reviews.x: Picture shows three different types of concealer shades, however it does just send ONE shade. So this package I got three creamy beige tubes. It works wonders! Quick and Easy! Picture I posted is compared to a regular sized lipstick. Hope this helps your shopping! :)

reviews.t: Love it.
reviews.x: I've been dying to try these LA girl concealer. I see girls use them all the time in make up tutorials and it's a must have ! This set came with three of the same color and size concealers (creamy beige).  I wouldn't say full coverage but it does the job. The only thing that I dislike about it is that the applicator is a brush. You squeeze it and it comes out the brush.  Otherwise I love it ! Will be ordering more soon.

reviews.t: Hmmmmm....Yes For the Cost
reviews.x: I am straddling the fence on this product.  I may be critiquing a bit harshly, considering that this is a drugstore product and the cost was minimum.  On one hand this is a surprising little gem for a high end makeup lover, such as myself.  Albeit, I expected the consistency to be a bit thicker, but it wears well without creasing and the applicator does not clog or get goopy as I expected. As a matter of fact, the thinner consistency became a bonus in the warmer months when I wear lighter textur

reviews.t: I overlooked the product details
reviews.x: I did not realize they were going to be all the same color.  Photo is deceiving but then again I need to read the details I guess

reviews.t: LA Girl concealer
reviews.x: LA Girl concealer works well as a highlighter.  I love it's consistency and how it works well with my banana powder.

reviews.t: LA Girl Pro Concealer in Creamy Beige
reviews.x: Great concealer! My complexion is medium and the color I purchased "creamy beige" is perfect for brightening my under eyes. It has the slightest tint of peach which is great for concealing my dark circles. I love the 3 pack. I have one in my purse, one on my makeup vanity and one on my bathroom counter.

reviews.t: One of the best, most affordable concealers I've EVER found!
reviews.x: I don't know how I ever lived without this concealer. I saw it in a YouTube video, got three at a great price here, and LOVE the coverage. Another thing that is great is that it does not cake or dry out your under eyes. Well worth the purchase.

reviews.t: This concealer feels a little thick but thats good! Its full coverage and it lasts all day
reviews.x: This concealer feels a little thick but thats good! Its full coverage and it lasts all day! It doesn't crease on me when i set it with a powder. 3 for $8 ? Now thats a steal ! Specially for such a great product. Unfortunately the packaging sucks and I really have to squeeze that product out. But other than the packaging I love it

reviews.t: Not good. Be careful before you buy!!!
reviews.x: The product seems different that what i had before when I ordered it from someone else it was greasy and even with setting powder, it still melted like butter sliding out of place and creased under my eye. The color was off and I could not return it. I strongly don't like that I cannot return it. It would have been 3 stars just for the fast delivery but the return issue is a problem.

reviews.t: I'm not happy with my purchase
reviews.x: I'm not happy with my purchase. I ordered this thinking I was getting three separate shades, but I got 3 of the same color. The image for the product is VERY deceiving and not an accurate depiction of what you're getting and now I can't return it.

reviews.t: Blends in great!
reviews.x: I like the end result, but I'm not feeling the applicator. Sometimes, too much comes out and I hate wasting makeup! I think if it had a different type of applicator, I would definitely give it 5 stars. It conceals great though.

reviews.t: Awesome Deal! I usually buy my L
reviews.x: Awesome Deal! I usually buy my L.A Girl products at the swapmeet or at discount stores but at this price it was a steal! Consistency is creamy and easy to apply! Overall Love it and will buy again!

reviews.t: Good Product
reviews.x: I do like this concealer but it is a little darker than I expected.  But I like the consistency and can probably mix a little lighter shade in to get a perfect match for my skin.

reviews.t: Less is more
reviews.x: Really pigmented! And heavy duty coverage! Less is more

reviews.t: Five Stars
reviews.x: Excellent quality! Very blendable and good coverage!

reviews.t: I can see why others would like it, however
reviews.x: I had high hopes for this product, but I have to say that it didn't do the job for me. I have very thin skin under my eyes, and a lot of concealers tend to break up on the skin--and this did for me. I can see why others would like it, however. If your under eyes are similar to the rest of your face, i.e. the skin texture is thicker and more smooth, this concealer will be fine. Full coverage concealer, very thick formulation. It feels quite heavy.

reviews.t: it looks like the first tube in the picture
reviews.x: When the product arrived I was scared because it looked a lot darker than I wanted, it looks like the first tube in the picture, however when I squeezed it out of the tube I was pleasantly surprised to learn it changes to the lighter color (the furthest right color in the picture) and goes on very light. Writing this for people who are like me and were confused about what color you'll be getting

reviews.t: the concealer looked like someone just stuck their 5-year old makeup in a ...
reviews.x: I thought this product came in different colors as seen in the pictures. A lighter color, neutral color, and a darker color. It came in three of the same color and it did not match my skin at all. When applying to my face it would not blend as well, the concealer looked like someone just stuck their 5-year old makeup in a box and shipped it to me. I hate it!

reviews.t: Good value but I find that "Real Deal" concealer works ...
reviews.x: Did not live up to the hype for me unfortunately.  Good value but I find that "Real Deal" concealer works much butter at concealing my dark under eye circles.  This will cover dark circle but with lots of reapplication to achieve the effect.

reviews.t: Deceiving picture.
reviews.x: I thought these came in a light, medium, and dark color, like shown in the picture - they do not. Waste of my money. I don't think I saw anything in the description distinguishing that they were all the same color at the time.

reviews.t: Way darker than expected. Contains so much oil that ...
reviews.x: Way darker than expected. Contains so much oil that you'll need to use rice paper thru the day to dab that grease away. Wont ever be buying this again, i wash my face everyday and my face broke out within five hours of wear.

reviews.t: I love these concealers as I have age spots and dark ...
reviews.x: I love these concealers  as I have age spots and dark circles.  The color was spot on and worked under make up.  Stays on all day long.  Would order again.  Thanks for a great product!

reviews.t: You need this in your life !
reviews.x: Love the consistency of this concealer and the price! This is perfect for people that are new to makeup and want to try out an affordable concealer! It's truly a great product!

reviews.t: You need to apply it with a sponge otherwise it ...
reviews.x: You need to apply it with a sponge otherwise it will look streaky and cake up on your dry spots. Other than that when you apply it with a sponge it works well and covers well.

reviews.t: Like other reviewer said
reviews.x: Like other reviewer said, It's all the same shade which is creamy beige. It's kinda dark on my skin when I applied it, so not really happy with it.. Shipping was fast though!

claims.text: Many reviewers note the product arrives as three tubes of the same shade (creamy beige), and some found the product photo misleading since it shows multiple shades.
Reviewers frequently praise the value and affordability of getting three concealers at a low price.
Coverage and blendability are commonly praised, with several calling it good or full coverage and easy to blend.
Some reviewers complain about the packaging/applicator, saying it is hard to squeeze or dispenses too much product.
A few reviewers report issues with the formula or color, including creasing, greasiness, or a shade that was off or darker than expected.
